cases.title: Encode canonical loose objects
cases.failure_hypothesis: A codec could hash payload alone or omit the canonical header while generic compression tests still pass.
cases.oracle: Published Git blob OID and literal inflated whole; fixed independently authored stored-block decoder input; output compression bytes unconstrained.
cases.distinctness: Git whole-object header/OID/native zlib boundary from the actual OS codec; earlier cases cover generic native transform concurrency, not a valid loose-object format.
preconditions: Exact byte-pinned production module and unmodified license; exact separately qualified direct-celld runtime and trusted bundle.
All unconditional imports must resolve: genuine node:zlib and exact pako3.0.2 with historical integrity, regardless of case function. No source evaluation occurs until separately authorized.
Fresh owned deployment/process with genuine crypto.subtle/DigestStream, native byte/BYOB streams and modern JS globals; external process/domain limits and full cleanup witness.
trace: Encode literal blob and independently inflate exact header/payload
cases.schedule: One GET /case/X201 in a fresh owned deployment/process; exact sequential operations in one active fetch request; no concurrency or external service.

limits.memory_accounting: Decoded logical payload estimate only; no JS heap or native allocation measurement. Hex strings, temporary values, pako/native state and allocator overhead are bounded solely by the mandatory owned-domain RSS ceiling.
limits.descendant_supervision: Entire proven-owned runtime/dev/bundler domain including descendants across PGIDs; no single-process-group assumption.

cleanup: All iterator next calls and the final trailer/EOF completion must settle. In a finally block call generator.return(), which invokes production PackReader using/dispose cancellation on early exit; clear the retained-base map.
Observe finite source terminal counters. Production privately owns BYOB reader and digest; fixture cannot release its reader lock or prove native reclamation and never reaches into private state.

In all outcomes externally terminate and reap the full proven-owned runtime/dev/bundler descendant domain across PGIDs, then remove only its staging/bundle/log/temp/private-store artifacts. Enforce five-second cleanup bound; preserve bounded evidence outside that domain.
Unsettled work, missing dependency/runtime/ownership evidence or unsuccessful reap remains BLOCKED and cannot qualify as PASS. Do not race in-process cleanup with an unsettled trace.
